title: The four covers
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The laundromat owner has October's four covers on the counter in a row: the bags, the alley, the schedule's week, 101. She's kept one of each since the beginning. Sixty-one. Wood didn't know. She says somebody has to. He says the tech counts. She says counting's not keeping.

panels.composition: The laundromat counter. Four digests in a row: the bags on the porch; the buckets in the alley; the third; the highway's bend. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: four small booklets laid in a row on a laundromat counter, their covers a porch with bags, an alley with buckets, a third scene and a highway bend, the owner and a young man looking at them, black and white, no words
image.notes: Week 3's cover: not scripted (dw_2000-10-20 is a daily); the strip shows a third cover as shapes.

panels.composition: Under the counter: a shelf, a stack. Sixty-one digests. One of each.

image.prompt: close on a shelf beneath a counter holding a tall neat stack of small photocopied booklets, black and white, no words
a laundromat owner, level, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood looking at the stack. Sixty-one. The strip has an archive and it's under a laundromat counter and it didn't ask. Rain in the window, hatched.

image.prompt: a young man looking down at a stack of booklets beneath a laundromat counter with rain hatched in the window behind, black and white, no words

notes: 'Counting's not keeping.' Sixty-one under the counter. The archive.
